First release. Download **bambu-deck-0.1.0.streamDeckPlugin** and double-click it; Stream Deck installs the plugin along with its profiles.

- Bao key with every printer state, progress around the edge
- AMS spools (AMS, AMS lite, AMS 2 Pro, AMS HT, external spool), humidity and drying
- Temperatures, pause/resume, stop (hold), chamber light, speed, Stream Deck + dials
- Full-deck alarm when a print is done, fails, runs out of filament or reports a serious HMS error
- Up to four printers on your LAN, plus three demo printers
- Ready-made profiles for every Stream Deck model

Tested on an X1 Carbon with AMS; all other models are beta. UI in German for now.
